name: Badge
summary: A badge is a number pinned to something else, and a number on its own says nothing: 3 is not a count of anything until you say of what. The fix is a few words nobody sees, kept in the badge beside the digits, so the count arrives with its subject attached.
demoNote: Everything under Common mistakes is live, and every readout prints what the badge is actually read out as. On screen the failing badges and the correct ones are identical.

contract.useWhen: A count on a control, where the digits are not the thing being announced.
keyboard: native: reaches the control the badge is nested in, never the badge itself
states: zero — the badge is removed, never drawn with a 0 in it
failureModes: the digits are the whole badge, so its name is a bare number
aria-hidden on the badge, which deletes the count instead of naming it
the clipped subject added and the digits left unhidden, so the count is read twice
the badge positioned over the control rather than nested inside it, so its words join nothing
role=status on the badge: it interrupts, and it drops the count from the control's own name
